resolved_prompt: Compose one continuous single-view vertical image built around exactly one clearly adult woman as the only figure. Every visible face, body, and hand belongs to this same woman. Place a clearly visible strip of background above her entire hairstyle, and keep her complete crown, face, and both eyes clearly readable. The second character-design direction is the measured axis. Put its named face geometry and proportions on the visible subject. Translate its silhouette and layers into large asymmetric garment shapes, and repeat its seam curves and closures as front-readable clothing details. Photorealistic adult editorial treatment: large circular light pools, rounded shadows, and bold silhouette spacing. Use an amber-lit side and blue-shadowed side across subject and backdrop, fine paper fibers in backdrop and shadows while skin and fabric stay clear, deep evening values, narrow light paths, and tense still space, and soft color bloom and halation outside a readable silhouette. Combine it coherently with this second visual direction: An adult character has a soft rounded silhouette with gentle transitions and natural adult proportions, a square mature face with a strong jaw, broad brow, and restrained mouth, and statuesque adult proportions with an upright spine and measured limb length. The design is unified by restrained geometric fastenings and repeated seam angles that support a clear hierarchy. Resolve both directions on the same adult subject. Give every named visual cue an obvious, concrete location on the face, clothing, silhouette, lighting, or environment. Preserve the selected medium and keep the face, eyes, visible hands, joints, garment construction, and spatial relationships coherent. Finish the single scene cleanly with text-free, logo-free, watermark-free imagery. Final camera lock—frame literally from the complete crown through both feet, with generous visible background margin above the hairstyle and below both shoes.
